verdict_reason: The renamed keys are right, but the inline complete-notification fixture stores speciesLatinName as an array production never writes and copies set-up that gates.test.js and happy-path.json already hold.

todos.issue: completeAnswers stores speciesLatinName: ['Bos taurus'], an array. The app never writes that shape: commit-selection.js seedLine stores speciesLatinName as a string, line keys are code|latinName, and flow/fixtures/happy-path.json:11 holds 'Bos taurus'. The array is left over from renaming the array-valued speciesSelection one field at a time. The same array shape is in gates.test.js:157.
todos.fix: Must: every commodity line in this test's fixtures has the shape production stores, with speciesLatinName as a string. One way: change line 34 to speciesLatinName: 'Bos taurus', or take the line from the shared fixture (see the duplication item).

todos.issue: completeAnswers (lines 20-88, including the unitedKingdom constant) is a whole notification written out inline. gates.test.js:145-207 holds a near-identical copy (allAnswerSectionsReady), and flow/fixtures/happy-path.json already holds the shared complete notification that opening-run.test.js reads. This PR had to edit the same commodity line in both inline copies, which is the cost of copied set-up.
todos.fix: Must: the complete-notification seed for the flow tests lives in one shared place, and dispatch.test.js and gates.test.js both use it with no local copy. One way: read the values from ./fixtures/happy-path.json (as opening-run.test.js does), or export a completeAnswers helper beside it, and delete the inline object and the unitedKingdom constant here.
